fields.System.Title: INT-101 — Receive ASNs from the ERP
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want expected deliveries to arrive from the ERP automatically,
so that nobody types them in and nothing is missed.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid ASN message, then an ASN is created with its lines.
  • - Given an unknown product or supplier, then the message is rejected with a reason
  • naming the field and stored in the dead-letter table.
  • - Given the same message replayed, then exactly one ASN exists.
  • - Given an update for an ASN not yet received against, then it is applied.
  • - Given an update for an ASN already received against, then it is rejected and flagged
  • for a human.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inbound |
| Tables | asn, asn_line, dead-letter |
| Risks | Duplicate ASN ([doc 09 §3.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); silent drop ([doc 08 §6](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency |
